name: wait_really_false_positive
description: 'Wait, really? That's insane, how did...' keeps talking: no hold (and 'can't wait' is not a hold either).

turns.text: So I just got back from a climbing trip in Colorado last weekend.
No way, I have always wanted to go climbing out there. Which area?
We were near Boulder, mostly the Flatirons, which honestly have the best views ever.
That sounds amazing, I mostly climb indoors at the gym near campus right now.
Wait, really? That's insane, how did you even get in?
My friend knew the guide, so we just showed up early and asked nicely.
Honestly the next trip is in two weeks and I can't wait.
Two weeks is so soon, you have to send me pictures from the top.
